item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY's Four Trailers Rumored To Feature [SPOILER]; Will Begin With Anti-Piracy PSA (LOL)
item.description: New details about Marvel Studios' plans for the four Avengers: Doomsday trailers have been revealed, including how they'll end. Will a PSA stop fans from recording them, though?

item.title: Supposed Silver Surfer Candidate In FANTASTIC FOUR Replaces Former Kang Actor Jonathan Majors In New Film
item.description: LaKeith Stanfield, at one point speculated to play an alternate version of Silver Surfer in Fantastic Four: First Steps, is set to replace former Kang actor Jonathan Majors in upcoming NBA-related movie.

item.title: MAN OF TOMORROW: This GUARDIANS OF THE GALAXY Star Is Reportedly The Frontrunner For Brainiac
item.description: According to the latest intel, the frontrunner to portray Brainiac in Man of Tomorrow is someone who's previously portrayed an alien in James Gunn's Guardians of the Galaxy film series.

item.title: RUMOR: SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY Will See Peter Parker And The Punisher Battle The [SPOILER] Version Of Hulk
item.description: A wild new Spider-Man: Brand New Day rumour reveals that Tom Holland's wall-crawler will team up with Jon Bernthal's Punisher to battle a unique version of the Savage Hulk.

item.title: MAN OF TOMORROW: James Gunn Says NONE Of The Rumored Names Are Correct For Brainiac, Including Dave Bautista
item.description: Man of Tomorrow director James Gunn has said that none of the names rumoured to be in the running for the DCU's Brainiac are correct, and reminds fans that he's never said the villain is in the movie.

item.title: The Last PLUS ULTRA! Deku, All Might And More Bid Farewell As MY HERO ACADEMIA Anime Concludes
item.description: After nine years, 181 episodes, and four feature films, the My Hero Academia anime has officially come to an end, with its final episode airing in Japan and streaming on Crunchyroll.

item.title: STREET FIGHTER Teaser Trailer Hides An Unannounced World Warrior Right Under Your Nose
item.description: The appearance of this Street Fighter character in the teaser trailer strongly suggests the film may be packed with additional surprise cameos.

item.title: DEADPOOL’s Ryan Reynolds Addresses Quentin Tarantino Controversy With Ad Starring SCOOBY-DOO’s Matthew Lillard
item.description: Following Quentin Tarantino’s disparaging comment about Matthew Lillard, Deadpool star Ryan Reynolds supported the actor with a Mint Mobile add.

item.title: IT: WELCOME TO DERRY Finale Ending Explained: Another Pennywise Twist As Stage Is Set For Season 2 - SPOILERS
item.description: We're taking a deep dive into the It: Welcome to Derry finale, including that game-changing Pennywise the Clown twist and how the stage is set for an even more terrifying Season 2.
